events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the 35th anniversary of the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: A tribute to a legend
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost him, but Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen track?

angles.copy: It's been 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Still sounds as fresh as ever, doesn't it?
